block.create.flywheel.tooltip.summary: Stores _kinetic energy_ while spinning, which can keep connected machinery running after the drive is disconnected.
block.create.controller_rail.tooltip.sum: A _uni-directional_ powered rail. _Signal strength_ sets the cart's _target speed_; acceleration and braking are gradual.
block.create.nozzle.tooltip.summary: Attach to the front of an _Encased Fan_ to push or pull _entities_ in _all directions_.
item.create.goggles.tooltip.behaviour1: _Kinetic components_ show _speed, inertia, torque and structural strength_. _Load Gauges_ show network load. Other blocks reveal information such as item and fluid content. Hold _Sneak_ for energy and power.
block.differentialcreate.gear_lever.tool: _Right-click_ to shift up; _sneak-right-click_ to shift down.
differentialcreate.ponder.dynamics.text_: Limited power makes shafts speed up and slow down gradually.
Disconnect the input shaft: energy stored in the Flywheel keeps the press working.
The small cog turns faster and drives the upper press.
Add two Copper Ingots to each press together; the faster press finishes first.
differentialcreate.ponder.clutch.header: Disconnecting Clutches and Using the Brass Clutch
differentialcreate.ponder.clutch.text_1: The engaged Clutch passes rotation from the input to the Drill.
differentialcreate.ponder.clutch.text_2: Set redstone to 15: the Clutch opens while the input keeps turning.
differentialcreate.ponder.clutch.text_3: Slowing the input leaves the disconnected output spinning independently.
differentialcreate.ponder.clutch.text_4: Empty-hand hold right-click on the Brass panel to adjust engagement.
differentialcreate.ponder.ratio.header: Adjusting Speed and Direction with the Ratio Controller
differentialcreate.ponder.ratio.text_1: Set the lower shaft/top cog speed ratio, from -16 to +16.
differentialcreate.ponder.ratio.text_2: Set -1: the lower shaft reverses relative to the top cog.
differentialcreate.ponder.ratio.text_3: Set 0: the input keeps turning, with the output disconnected.
differentialcreate.ponder.ratio.text_4: Set +2: the lower shaft spins twice as fast.
differentialcreate.ponder.ratio.text_5: Ctrl + right-click sets precise ratios, here +1.5.
differentialcreate.ponder.load_gauge.hea: Reading Power Demand with the Load Gauge
differentialcreate.ponder.load_gauge.tex: Load compares sustained power demand with available drive power, excluding stored inertia.
Midscale means 100%% load and signal 8; infinite overload gives 15.
Without power, spinning on inertia gives no load reading or redstone signal.
Use Goggles to read the current power demand and supply.
differentialcreate.ponder.speed_gauge.he: Measuring Shaft Speed and Adjusting Dial Range
differentialcreate.ponder.speed_gauge.te: The Speedometer measures actual speed at its own shaft.
Hold right-click on the dial with a Wrench to change its range.
differentialcreate.ponder.pump_direction: Watch the pump arrow and the changing levels in both tanks.
Use a Wrench to change the pump direction: water slows, then reverses.
Cut the drive; water and the pump keep moving briefly.
differentialcreate.ponder.pump_network.t: An empty pipe contains air. Watch this glass section.
Fill the supply tank and start the pump: water pushes air ahead.
Watch the receiving tank rise as water flows into it.
differentialcreate.ponder.bearing.header: Assembling Bearings and Spinning After Power Is Cut
differentialcreate.ponder.bearing.text_1: Empty-hand right-click assembles the beam; input power starts it turning.
differentialcreate.ponder.bearing.text_2: Lower the input speed; the beam gradually slows down.
differentialcreate.ponder.bearing.text_3: Cutting power leaves the beam assembled and spinning on inertia.
differentialcreate.ponder.structure_load: Moving Structures and Powering Their Tools
Input power moves the carriage along the gantry shaft.
The Harvester spends power when it contacts mature crops.
Reverse the input to bring the Harvester back.
differentialcreate.ponder.continuous_wor: Slow Processing and Working After Power Is Cut
Watch the press complete a copper sheet as its shaft turns.
A slower input makes the next pressing stroke slower.
Cut power: the Flywheel finishes this last copper sheet.
differentialcreate.ponder.ejector_work.t: Turn the input shaft to charge the Ejector.
Once charged, cut power and add an ingot: it still launches.
Choose a nearer target; the next ingot lands on the middle Depot.
differentialcreate.ponder.crusher_work.h: Crushing Wheel Speeds and Feeding Items
differentialcreate.ponder.crusher_work.t: Same-way rotation can crush items when the wheels turn at different speeds.
Wheel speeds and directions decide which side accepts items.
On screen, left -16 and right -32 feed downward.
Throw items in from the feed side; here, from above.
differentialcreate.ponder.steam_power.te: Heat and water start both engines on this boiler.
Both engines draw steam from this same boiler.
Remove the heat sources to stop steam supply. Unloaded engines keep spinning on inertia.
differentialcreate.ponder.train_power.te: Before assembly, install power by using a Steam Engine on a bogey.
Connect the boiler and powered bogey with a Steam Hose, within 48 blocks.
Fit a Condenser Pipe on the bogey to recover 90%% of steam water.
Separate tanks supply water; chests/barrels supply fuel. Vaults cannot supply fuel.
Driving, Shifting Gears, and Stopping Trains
W accelerates; S brakes. Install a Gear Lever for X/Z shifting.
Neutral disconnects the wheels; pressing W still runs the engine.
Brake near the station; stop before finishing your drive.
When stopped, right-click the Controls again to finish driving.
differentialcreate.ponder.portable_docki: Select Wait for Redstone with a Wrench. Empty interfaces stay connected until powered.
While Docked keeps the comparator at 15 until the heads fully retract.
Docking Stage outputs 0 when idle, 8 while docking or retracting, and 15 when connected.
differentialcreate.ponder.minecart_dynam: The loaded minecart gradually accelerates when the rails drive it.
The second cart and attached cargo travel together with the first.
Reverse the rails: the carts slow down before changing direction.
differentialcreate.ponder.sequencer.head: Sequenced Gearshift Angles and Holding Position
differentialcreate.ponder.sequencer.text: This program turns forward twice, then back half a turn.
It slows near the target angle, then holds position.
Once it finishes, another redstone pulse starts the program again.
differentialcreate.ponder.fan_work.text_: Air passing through lava smelts the ore into an ingot.
Raise the speed and add another ore: faster blades, the same processing time.
Cut power: the fan slows and its airflow weakens.
create.ponder.creative_motor.text_2: Set rated RPM here; unloaded speed approaches twice that.
create.ponder.fluid_pipe_flow.text_5: The windows show the liquid now moving through the pipes.
create.ponder.fluid_pipe_flow.text_6: Watch both tanks: the source level falls while the receiver rises.
create.ponder.fluid_pipe_flow.text_7: The pipes also hold liquid, so the two tank changes need not match.
create.ponder.crushing_wheels.text_2: This opposing rotation draws items into the gap.
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_11: Step onto a charged Ejector to launch, consuming its full charge.
create.ponder.train_assembly.text_8: Boilers draw onboard water from separate tanks and fuel from chests/barrels.
create.ponder.cart_assembler_rails.text_: Powered and Controller Rails apply finite propulsion and braking; heavier carts respond slower.
create.ponder.track_chunks.text_2: Powering trains still consumes resources in unloaded chunks.
create.ponder.valve_handle.text_5: Stopped Bearings stay assembled; empty-hand right-click disassembles them.
create.ponder.cart_assembler_rails.text_: Furnace Carts take coal/charcoal from eligible storage, excluding Vaults.
create.ponder.smart_pipe.text_4: Set different filters on the two branches to separate the liquids.
create.ponder.smart_pipe.text_5: Watch chocolate and milk flow through separate branches into their own tanks.
differentialcreate.ponder.shared.bearing: Right-click the Bearing with an empty hand to assemble or disassemble it.
create.ponder.clutch.text_2: At Redstone strength 15, the connection opens; the output can coast.
Ratio Controllers relay rotation between their axis and a Large Cogwheel above them
The side panel sets the lower-shaft/top-cog ratio; negative reverses and zero disconnects.
create.ponder.stressometer.header: Monitoring Kinetic Load using the Load Gauge
create.ponder.stressometer.text_1: The Load Gauge displays sustained power demand relative to available drive power
create.ponder.stressometer.text_3: Comparators report load: 100%% gives signal 8; no drive gives zero.
create.ponder.mechanical_bearing.text_2: Right-click with an empty hand to assemble; rotational force then drives the structure.
create.ponder.bearing_modes.header: Assembling and Disassembling the Mechanical Bearing
create.ponder.bearing_modes.text_1: Right-click with an empty hand to disassemble at the nearest grid-aligned angle.
create.ponder.bearing_modes.text_2: Cutting power keeps the structure assembled; right-click with an empty hand to disassemble.
create.ponder.sequenced_gearshift.text_1: Seq. Gearshifts follow configured instructions; angles and distances use actual output travel.
create.ponder.mechanical_pump_flow.text_: Their arrow indicates the direction of flow
The pumps direction is unaffected by the input rotation
Instead, a Wrench can be used to reverse the direction
create.ponder.mechanical_pump_speed.text: Mechanical Pumps affect the loaded connected pipe network, without a fixed 16-block range.
Speeding up the input changes the pressure supplied by the pump...
Use a Wrench to reverse this pump's arrow. It now pushes back.
create.ponder.portable_storage_interface: This component exchanges items after braking the contraption to a stop, without disassembling it.
Facing interfaces brake and connect when aligned; excessive speed can overshoot.
After transfers stop, the interfaces retract before the contraption resumes moving.
create.ponder.portable_fluid_interface.t: This component exchanges fluid after braking the contraption to a stop, without disassembling it.
Facing interfaces brake and connect when aligned; excessive speed can overshoot.
After transfers stop, the interfaces retract before the contraption resumes moving.
create.ponder.train_controls.text_2: With steam power, water and fuel installed, right-click the assembled Controls to drive.
create.ponder.train_controls.text_3: W admits steam, S brakes; A and D steer at junctions.
create.ponder.train_controls.text_4: Install a Gear Lever to shift with X/Z; the mouse wheel no longer sets a speed limit.
create.ponder.train_controls.text_5: Hold Space for station approach and parking; brake early to avoid overshooting.
create.ponder.mechanical_pump_speed.text: All three pumps move lava to the other tank together.
